purpose: Test the directed quotient-scar operatorization and its QR-003 composition null without claiming a fundamental Spin(2,3) carrier.
hardwareClass: active non-Hermitian acoustic or equivalent programmable directed-wave network

network.sufficientStabilityCondition: kappa > 7 |g| for uniform link scale g

observables.path: Y2 = <Omega|A^2|Omega>; two-tone derivatives recover the symmetrized path matrix
observables.triangle: Y3 is the polarized sum over the eleven undirected graph triangles
observables.tomography: full complex transfer matrix over drive frequency, not intensity alone

drive.primary: modulate QR-003 with calibrated amplitude delta and sweep omega
drive.partnerProbe: repeat with each edge as the second bilinear slot or use equivalent two-tone Hessian tomography
drive.reversalControl: inject a calibrated reverse QR-003 amplitude epsilon
drive.seamControl: inject QR-002 separately; keep QR-004 and QR-013 disabled during the first-order wall test

exactPredictions.reciprocalLeakageLaw: s_min = ||wall column|| = 4 |epsilon| until it meets the visible spectrum
exactPredictions.gainDisorder: arbitrary nonzero directed edge rescaling preserves the exact QR-003 null
exactPredictions.hermitianCompletion: changes the claim by producing a QR-003 two-step return

calibrations: measure forward and reverse complex transfer on every link
fit amplifier gain, phase and added noise independently
measure direct pickup with all partner probes disabled
toggle QR-002 to determine its wall-response template
repeat the singular-value reconstruction across frequency and drive amplitude
verify linear and quadratic scaling using fundamental and second-harmonic lock-in channels

acceptance.emulatorPass: After subtracting calibrated reciprocal leakage, QR-002 seam response and direct pickup, the QR-003 composition residual is statistically consistent with zero while the other 23 directions retain rank.
acceptance.graphFalsifier: A coherent residual QR-003 path or triangle response persists across frequency and amplitude with scaling inconsistent with calibrated leakage or seam templates.
acceptance.physicsPromotionGate: An independent observable dictionary identifies the sixteen modes and directed couplings with a physical carrier and derives rather than programs their amplitudes.
